cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：足够的
cards.example_en: We have sufficient food for a week.
cards.example_zh: 我们有足够的食物吃一周。

cards.example_en: The cat's tail knocked a cup off the low table.
cards.example_zh: 猫的尾巴把矮桌上的杯子碰掉了。

cards.example_en: Do not use a rude tone when you ask for help.
cards.example_zh: 向别人求助的时候，不要用粗鲁的语气。

cards.example_en: The cat may upset the milk bowl on the kitchen table.
cards.example_zh: 猫可能会打翻厨房桌上的牛奶碗。

cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：有效的
cards.example_en: Your student card is valid until the end of June.
cards.example_zh: 你的学生卡到六月底都有效。

cards.example_en: The concert venue is a hall near the railway station.
cards.example_zh: 音乐会的地点是火车站附近的一座大厅。

cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：野生的；狂野的
cards.example_en: We saw wild ducks on the lake behind school.
cards.example_zh: 我们在学校后面的湖上看见了野鸭。

cards.example_en: The bird hurt its left wing and could not fly.
cards.example_zh: 那只鸟伤了左翅膀，飞不起来了。

cards.example_en: Wow! You finished the puzzle so fast.
His presence at the match made the younger players cheer.
cards.example_zh: 他出席比赛，让年轻队员们欢呼起来。

cards.scene: 时间数字 · Time Numbers and Quantity
cards.example_en: The charity run raised one hundred yuan from our class.
cards.example_zh: 这次慈善长跑从我们班筹到了一百元。

cards.scene: 时间数字 · Time Numbers and Quantity
cards.example_en: The villagers left an offering of flowers at the old shrine.
cards.example_zh: 村民们在旧神龛前留下了鲜花作为供品。

cards.scene: 时间数字 · Time Numbers and Quantity
cards.example_en: Careful planning kept the picnic dry and cheerful.
cards.example_zh: 规划做得仔细，野餐既没淋雨，大家也很开心。

cards.scene: 时间数字 · Time Numbers and Quantity
cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：相等的
cards.example_en: Both teams had equal numbers of players after the change.
cards.example_zh: 调整之后，两队的球员人数相等。

cards.scene: 时间数字 · Time Numbers and Quantity
cards.example_en: Mum bought a dozen bread rolls for the class picnic.
cards.example_zh: 妈妈为班级野餐买了一打小面包。
